profile.headline: Software Engineer at Ford Motor Company
profile.summary:
I am a Detroiter with a passion for technology and education.

I am interested in participating in exciting ventures, initiatives or programs that aim to help all Detroiters, especially Detroiters in the Latinx community, through education or technology.

Please feel free to reach out to me via email at luisgonzalezyante@gmail.com

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Working with the Credit Application Processing Engine team in Ford Credits’s Dealer Originations department.

* Assisting with a confidential project impacting core business systems (subject to NDA)
* Led development of API to provide loan applicant information for internal use
* On-boarded, coached, and advised 3 junior engineers during their rotations with our team
* Addressed production issues as needed during weeklong on-call rotations
* Migrated 5 micro services from on-prem to GCP
* Modernized parts of a loan originations legacy application into 4 maintainable and scalable micro services with async messaging, REST APIs, and robust logging
positions.insights: Skills: Spring Boot · Java · Google Cloud Platform (GCP) · SQL · REST APIs

positions.title: Mentor
positions.description:
• Interacts with a group of 6 high schoolers
• Co-designing and building a prototype Arduino based air quality sensor with students
• Will engage students in developing an Ionic App to display air quality data collected by the sensors

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: As an IT FCG, I gained experience as a Backend Software Engineer on the Global Middleware team within Ford Credits’s Dealer Originations department. I helped rewrite the validation portion of a legacy application as a cloud micro service.

positions.title: eCommerce Product Manager
positions.description: As an IT FCG, I gained experience as an eCommerce Product Manager on the EMP and Reporting & Analytics product teams within Ford Marketing, Sales & Services. With both product teams, I helped deliver features to provide a more complete digital retail experience on Ford's eCommerce platform for consumers, dealers, and business.

positions.title: TaaS Software Engineer
positions.description: As an IT FCG, I gained experience as a Transportation as a Service Software Engineer on the GoRide product team within Ford Mobility. Worked with Java, Spring Boot, and React tech stack.

positions.title: Powertrain NA Site Process Management IT Intern
positions.description:
・Developed a resource that explains plant department applications, network, and data flow to show the impact of the loss of any applications and to expedite on boarding of new hires 
・Improved usability, usefulness, and intuitiveness of NA PTO SPM SharePoint site for NA plant IT managers and teams 
・Facilitated and developed a  4-year recruitments plan for  Ford’s recruitment team return to Princeton
・Aided in multiple company wide IT initiatives

positions.title: Backend Engineering Intern
positions.description:
Frank Financial Aid is a startup that is revolutionizing financial aid through technology, data, and design. Frank prepares student's FAFSA and maximizes their financial aid.

My duties were the following:
・Built the back end portion of the MVP
・Designed the MVP's database
・Defined and implemented appropriate abstractions for the MVP's back end 
・Designed a portion of the back end RESTful API
・Configured and managed 2 servers; a dev and production server
・Helped construct a bit of the front end of the MVP

positions.title: Instructor
positions.description:
Zambian Institute for Sustainable Development is an NGO dedicated to transforming Zambia into a prosperous nation and empowering its people through sustainable socio-economic development using a unique, multifaceted approach to alleviating poverty.

My duties were the following:
・Developed 2 month long curriculums: Java and Web Development curriculums
・Taught the both long curriculums to a total of 25 to 30 students
・Coordinated the completion of student group coding projects

positions.title: Curriculum Design Intern
positions.description:
Grand Circus is an inspired learning institute in the heart of downtown Detroit. They offer coding bootcamps that give people tech skills for today's job market and connect our graduates with local tech companies that are seeking top talent.

My duties were the following:
•  Developed a 3 hour Intro to Programming Workshop that is still offered today
•  Taught the pilot Intro to Programming Workshop to a group of 15 students

positions.title: Board Member
positions.description:
Grace In Action Collectives is a nonprofit organization established to over see youth-led and adult-lead collectives, such as Radical Productions who’s board is comprised of well abled youth to experienced adults.

My duties were the following:
• Kept board updated on Radical Productions activities.
• Talked to potential funders to earn capital to expand our collective’s
• Exercised power to vote for bylaws and other decisions.

positions.title: Cofounder - Head Web Developer
positions.description:
Radical Productions is a youth technology collective that teaches youth web development skills such as HTML, CSS, and Javascript, as well as graphic design. The youth also put these skills to use by providing web and graphic design services to local businesses and organizations.

My duties were the following:
• Developed, built, and launched websites for2  local businesses and organizations.
• Taught 5 Radical Productions members how to develop and create websites.
• Negotiated contracts and conducted business with clients.
• Led team meetings.
• Gave pitches to potential clients.
• Served as Project Manager for web development team

positions.title: Web Development Intern
positions.description:
Are You A Human is a start up company that provides an interactive and brand engaging gamified alternative to captcha, recaptcha,
and the video skip button.

My duties were the following:
• Helped start the development of a game creator for internal use by AYAH, which will help cut down on the development time of
the games.

positions.title: Web Development Intern
positions.description:
Detroit Venture Partners is a venture capital firm that invests in early-stage digital technology companies.

My duties were the following:
• Conducted market research and analysis on the Health and Fitness Industry.
• Worked with portfolio companies, Grand Circus and Are You A Human.
• Helped develop a start-up idea and business plan with a group of interns.
• Developed a web version of the start-up idea’s Minimum Viable Product.
• Pitched the start-up idea to DVP’s partners and analysts.

positions.title: Intern
positions.description:
Grand Circus is an inspired learning institute in the heart of downtown Detroit. They offer coding bootcamps that give people tech skills for today's job market and connect our graduates with local tech companies that are seeking top talent.

My duties were the following:
• Developed a curriculum for Grand Circus'​ Hacker Society program which targets middle to high school students.
• Helped to conduct research into viable revenue models for Grand Circus’s entrepreneurial course.
• Helped develop the early foundation of a revenue plan for Grand Circus's entrepreneurial course.

volunteerExperiences.description:
I've volunteered at Western International High School in Detroit for the following school years / courses
* 2018 - 2019 : Intro to Computer Science
* 2019 - 2020 : AP CSP
* 2020 - now : AP CSA

I help assist the teacher with daily classroom activities, grading assignment, helping students during labs, and teaching lessons.

projects.title: RevealEditor
projects.description:
An editor for coding demonstrations designed for the HTML presentation platform reveals.js.
The editor will allow for Javascript, HTML, and CSS coding without ever exiting the fullscreen presentation.

projects.title: Princeton's Society of Professional Engineers Website
projects.description:
As tech chair for Princeton's SHPE chapter, I rebuilt the organization's website from the ground up. 
Edit: As co-president, I gave the website another make over.

organizations.name: Princeton Quadrangle Club
organizations.position: Undergraduate Treasurer, Assistant House/Tech Chair · Jan 2016 - Present

organizations.name: Princeton's Chapter of Society of Hispanic Professional Engineers
